etsy.title: Christmas Coloring Pages for Kids Printable, 24 Easy Bold Holiday Coloring Sheets, Toddler Preschool Christmas Activity, Instant Download
etsy.description:
Big, simple Christmas pictures that little hands can actually color.

WHAT'S INSIDE (28 pages, US Letter + A4 PDF)
• 24 cute holiday coloring pages: Santa, snowman, reindeer, puppy, kitten, gingerbread, Christmas tree and more
• Thick, bold outlines, no tiny details – perfect for crayons and markers
• A color test page and a "Great job!" certificate

PERFECT FOR
• Toddlers and preschoolers ages 2–5
• Classroom Christmas parties and daycare
• Rainy afternoons and restaurant waits

HOW IT WORKS
INSTANT DIGITAL DOWNLOAD. No physical item will be shipped. Print at home or at a print shop, as many times as you need for your family.

For personal use only. Please do not resell or share the files.

Designed by our small shop, AureliaVenn, with the help of AI tools.
